Sub: Verification of the data provided in MIS 105 in respect of contribution
received from Exempted Sector for the year 2010-11 — regarding.

Sir,

On scrutiny of consolidated Annual MIS Return No. 105 for the year 2010-11, it is
observed that many Regions have not indicated the P.F contributions in respect of Exempted
Estts, under their jurisdiction.

Pa It is stated that MIS 105 gives the total picture of contributions recovered from the
subscribers/employees under the three schemes. However, in the context of the exempted
establishments there is an element of doubt on the correction of the data provided as many
Regions have reported ‘Nil ’ figures due to which the figures for all India is in lower side when
compared to the figures of 2009-10. It is therefore requested that the MIS 105 may
please be once again be verified at your end so that the corre¢t data is reported in
the Annual Report 2010-11. The consolidate. position of PF contribution received from
exempted sector is attached herewith as Annexure.

3 In case MIS for needs to be revised, the same may be sent through ACC (zones) by
15.07.2011 positively through e-mail at neomishg@yahoo.com or rc.mis@epfindia.gov.in

followed by hard copy.

Encl: As above Yours faithfully
